notes.title: THE ANNA LEE STORY now available!
notes.content:
[h2]Anna Lee has arrived! And she's asked you on a date?!?!?![/h2]

Download the update, open the game, and hit START to get the free all-new story in the LIFE AFTER MAGIC world, featuring new art, new music tracks, and plenty of surprises along the way!
(please note that you will need to complete one play-through of LIFE AFTER MAGIC to access this DLC!)

Experience this unique and poignant chronicle, which delves into the background of Anna Lee and her relationship with Akiko.  

[h2]Available to play now![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731829/07f79e18d9977b8d357ace2ff0acd7bd2761695b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731829/57fb71260ed29328064ef7a511b5346667a62ffd.png[/img]

notes.title: THE ANNA LEE STORY coming to LIFE AFTER MAGIC on April 20th!
notes.content:
[h2]Mark your calendars![/h2]

[h3]A new tale in the LIFE AFTER MAGIC universe is coming on [b]April 20th![/b] A fateful meeting with Anna Lee changes the course of events for Akiko and the Sentinels leading up to New Year's Eve 1999...and beyond![/h3]

[h3]Surprises are in store - with new revelations, added art, and new music tracks![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731829/07f79e18d9977b8d357ace2ff0acd7bd2761695b.png[/img]

Experience this unique and poignant chronicle, which delves into the background of Anna Lee and her relationship with Akiko.  

We cannot wait to share this adventure with you on April 20th. See you in Diamond Cove!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731829/bb491430e87f848dd1d8f486128f617833902dba.png[/img]

notes.title: LIFE AFTER MAGIC now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]The LIFE AFTER MAGIC release is here and FREE TO PLAY! Grab your copy and enter the world of Diamond Cove![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731829/1c08acf41d4a85c8a035aa7e8db15bc4352cd093.png[/img]

Chirashi Games is so excited to bring you LIFE AFTER MAGIC, the first game distributed by Chirashi Games, developed with Team Starlight. The Chirashi team met working on this game, and this labor of love is what inspired us to form a company to share LIFE AFTER MAGIC with a wider audience and continue to create games together. We hope you enjoy your time in Diamond Cove!

notes.title: LIFE AFTER MAGIC releases March 23rd on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]The LIFE AFTER MAGIC release is almost here! Starting [b]Thursday, March 23rd[/b], you can enter the world of Diamond Cove, reconnect with the Sentinels, and juggle life as an ex-magical girl with the mystery of magic's disappearance.[/h3]
[h3]
Wishlist LIFE AFTER MAGIC today to be alerted the moment it releases![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43731829/578a53dc0e2d9de215bca4559b3215f9ad1264e6.gif[/img]
